subject: Post-call: procurement decision criteria + payment path (PO vs card)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement decision criteria + payment path

Emily — thanks for the 30-min call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has a clear path. Please correct anything I get wrong below.

Call highlights (short):
- Procurement preference: PO through Ariba portal (procurement@novushealth.com) is their preferred path; Azure Marketplace is possible but requires price parity/marketplace listing.
- Payment: PO is primary; company card ok for initial pilot (<= $10k) but larger commitments will go on PO.
- Approvals: economic buyer = Alan Chen (CFO); finance sponsor = Gloria Patel (dir. finance); signatory path likely CEO for contract > $250k.
- Compliance asks: DPA and SOC2 evidence will be requested by procurement.

Redwood next steps (we volunteered):
1) Send a concise commercial summary + sample order form (PO-friendly) and W-9 — action: Stephanie (me) today.
2) Share a simple Mutual Action Plan that maps stakeholders, decision dates, and required docs — action: Ben to draft PO path + marketplace option by EOD tomorrow.
3) Procurement sync: schedule a 30–45m kickoff with Alan + procurement contact to walk the PO process / Ariba steps — propose Wed 9/13 or Thu 9/14.

Questions for you (short):
- Confirm procurement contact email (I have procurement@novushealth.com).
- Is Azure Marketplace of interest if we can offer identical pricing and term flow?
- Target procurement completion date (you mentioned end of month as a goal?)

Attachments: meeting-notes-20270907.txt (internal notes), mutual-action-plan-draft.csv (skeleton).

Thanks — will get the commercial summary and W-9 over this afternoon.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@novushealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T17:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement decision criteria + payment path

Thanks Stephanie — spot on. A few clarifications from our side:  

- Procurement contact: procurement@novushealth.com is correct and they use Ariba for vendor onboarding / PO ingestion.
- Authorizers: Alan Chen (CFO) is the economic buyer and will sign off the spend; Gloria Patel in finance will act as our sponsor and shepherd PO processing. I will loop both into the procurement kick-off.
- Marketplace: We would prefer Azure Marketplace for speed if you can list the SKU and keep price parity; otherwise Ariba PO is our standard enterprise path.
- Contract language: procurement will require a DPA and standard security attestation. They typically route legal redlines back through procurement@novushealth.com.
- Timing: target is close of month (2027-09-30) for an initial go/no-go. If procurement has everything (W-9, order form, DPA), we can make that window.

For the order form — we typically issue a PO referencing your order form/quote number. If you can provide a PO-ready order form with a Redwood order/quote #, that will speed ingestion. Also please include Redwood's Tax ID and a W-9.

I'll ask Alan and procurement to join the kickoff once you propose a date/time.

Best,
Emily Ross
Director, Digital Platforms | Novus Health
emily.ross@novushealth.com | +1 206-555-1133

- 9/09–9/10: Procurement reviews DPA/contract language; Redwood provides any clarifications.
- 9/13 or 9/14: Procurement kickoff meeting with Alan + procurement team.
- 9/30: Target procurement completion for pilot approval.

If Ariba ingestion ends up causing delays, we can propose a short pilot on a card (<= $10k) while procurement works the PO for full production.

Attachments: commercial-summary-Redwood.pdf, W9-Novus.pdf

Ben / Karthik — can you confirm you can turn the PO form around tomorrow? If there are specific legal terms procurement flags often, call those out so we can prepare our contract team.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
